stem.en: Kabir attacks. Which card does he play?

text.en: The flame, which passes every line. Then the mule, which fails one. Then the dry seed, which fails all of them.

feedback.en: The cloud fails "eat", "reproduce" and "respond", so the list correctly throws it out. Kabir's real weapons are the cards the list gets wrong, and the cloud is not one.

text.en: The robot vacuum, because it moves.

feedback.en: It fails "grow", "eat" and "reproduce". The list handles it. Kabir needs the three cards that break the list, not the ones it survives.

image.alt: An eight-year-old boy leaning across a verandah table holding up a playing card triumphantly, a notebook and a lit diya between him and the narrator.
